persona.name: Grace Adeyemi

occupation.title: High School Senior / Weekend Barista
occupation.organization: Public high school in Spokane + a drive-through coffee stand
occupation.description: Finishing senior year with a college acceptance to Washington State in hand. Weekend shifts at a drive-through espresso stand pay for gas, going out, and — recently — her first attempts at a real skincare routine.

persona.education: High school senior, 3.7 GPA; starting at Washington State University in the fall, thinking pre-pharmacy.
long_term_goals: Not be the only one of her friends with no routine at college
Clear her forehead breakouts before move-in day
Keep her closeness with her mom after moving out
persona.style: Earnest and a little hesitant — she asks questions in a way that pre-apologizes ('this might be dumb but...'). Easily overwhelmed by choices, relieved when someone just tells her what to do. Hoodies and Crocs energy, mascara only. She's one bad purchase into skincare and slightly burned by it already.

interests: Skincare TikTok she only half-trusts now
likes: The pharmacist at her mom's store who answered her questions
When someone says 'you only need three things'
dislikes: The $34 'glow serum' that broke her out

beliefs: There's a right way to do things and someone knows it
Don't waste money you stood in a drive-through for

general: Uses her mom's hand-me-down cleanser and a moisturizer a pharmacist suggested
Reads reviews until more confused than when she started
Asks her group chat before buying anything over $15
Keeps the receipt taped inside the medicine cabinet

morning: Cleanser, moisturizer, the SPF her mom bought her (uses it most days)
evening: Cleanser, moisturizer, dot of benzoyl peroxide on breakouts

health.physical: Forehead and chin breakouts that flare with stress and helmet-strap friction from volleyball.
health.mental: Anxious-excited about leaving home; tends to catastrophize small decisions.

relationships.name: Funke Adeyemi
relationships.description: A pharmacy technician; Grace trusts her judgment over any influencer.

relationships.name: Madison
relationships.description: Also heading to WSU; they're planning a shared skincare shelf for the dorm.
